title: Farm Puffs for Dried Kelp
description: Replaces the dried kelp with delectable farm puffs from abiotic factor!
body:
A resourcepack that replaces dried kelp with the delectable snack "Farm Puffs" from Abiotic Factor.

I have also made a version for both the baked potato, and golden carrot :

[FarmPuffsBakedPotato](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/farm-puffs-baked-potato)         
[FarmPuffsGoldenCarrot](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/farm-puffs-golden-carrot)

Be sure to check out Abiotic Factor on steam. It's a genuinely great multiplayer survival game

[AbioticFactorSteamLink](https://store.steampowered.com/app/427410/Abiotic_Factor/)
